title: Zephyr: Human-Readable Node Address Format implementation
description: Zephyr has lichen_pubkey_to_iid() in firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ipv6_addr.c but is missing the Crockford Base32 human address encoder (lichen_iid_to_human_address or similar). Need to add: 1) Crockford Base32 alphabet, 2) encode IID to 13 chars, 3) insert dashes at positions 4 and 8. Test against test/vectors/node_address.json
close_reason: Already fixed: Implementation exists in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_util.c (lichen_iid_to_human_address) and lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c (lichen_pubkey_to_human_address). Tests exist in lichen/tests/util/main.c and lichen/tests/link_crypto/src/main.c with 10 vectors. The firmware/bridge-zephyr/ path in the issue is stale - the canonical subsystem is lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/.
